description: ShopEase is an online shopping platform selling electronics, fashion and home products.
business_hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM

shipping.tracking: Tracking information is sent by email after dispatch.

returns.condition: Products must be unused and in original packaging.
returns.refund_time: 5-7 business days after the returned product is received.

faq.question: How can I track my order?
faq.answer: Tracking information is sent to your email after your order is dispatched.

faq.question: Can I cancel my order?
faq.answer: Orders can be cancelled before they are dispatched.

faq.question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
faq.answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for eligible orders.
